trigger_rule: Any ONE confirmed HIGH-severity red flag, OR two or more confirmed MODERATE red flags within the same domain
notes: Examples of always-HIGH: any caretaker hearing/speech concern; regression; no babbling by 12 mo; no words by 16 mo; no two-word phrases by 24 mo; no response to sound

trigger_rule: One confirmed MODERATE red flag, OR a milestone missed at the 75th-percentile threshold plus one supporting observation, OR persistent caretaker worry not meeting a HIGH flag
notes: OME-pattern findings sit here — moderate, but still route, because the cause is treatable

trigger_rule: A single milestone at or just past the edge of normal WITH protective indicators present (e.g. good gesture use, responds to name)
notes: Never 'no concern and discharge' for a borderline case — mirrors the ASQ-3 monitoring zone

trigger_rule: Caretaker cannot answer the key discriminating items, or has known the child too briefly to judge
action: Cannot grade — re-administer when a caretaker with sustained daily contact is available
notes: Never default to LOW when information is missing
Red flags outweigh missed milestones — a red flag is something that should never be present; a missed milestone is something not yet present

trigger_rule: Every grade must enumerate the exact citation_refs that produced it
notes: This is the regulatory requirement (ADR-03) — a clinician must be able to independently check the basis

trigger_rule: Evaluate milestones against the YOUNGER bound of the estimated range before flagging a delay
Widen the uncertainty band — a borderline delay under age uncertainty grades DOWN to monitor
notes: But age-independent red flags (regression, no response to sound, caretaker concern) grade UNCHANGED

trigger_rule: Surface 'age uncertain' explicitly in every output
notes: So the reviewing clinician can weight it

trigger_rule: Whenever speech/language is limited, check hearing first or alongside
notes: Hearing loss produces the same surface symptom as language delay (ADR-05)

trigger_rule: Never output a diagnostic label such as 'DLD'
notes: Name the observation ('expressive language below expectation for age'), grade urgency, route to clinician

trigger_rule: Any possible safeguarding signal routes OUT of developmental grading entirely
notes: Low escalation threshold — a single signal escalates, because the cost of a miss is severe
